title: States for the doubled-language machine
statement: Introduce a state type with the distinct states $vU0$, $vU1$, $vS$, $vW0$, $vWF$, $vWT$, $rw1$, $rw2$, $cnt$, $iC$, $iB$, $sw1$, $sw2$, $jK$, $jK2$, $jC$, $yes$, and $no$, together with states $jRB(b)$, $jI1(b)$, and $jI2(b)$ for each Boolean value $b$.
caveat: The constructors are given only as machine-state labels, with no mathematical meanings supplied; the names are retained as labels rather than interpreted as Lean identifiers.
